capabilities: apply background or text color highlights from a floating palette beside the selection
recolor or erase existing highlights, including native ==highlight== syntax
preserve nested bold, italic, and strikethrough Markdown formatting
customize visible colors, automatic popup behavior, and popup delay in settings
trigger each color as a command assignable to hotkeys
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese). Highlights are stored as HTML inside Markdown files, which may matter for users who want pure Markdown. Legacy pink highlights still render but are no longer in the picker.
problem: Obsidian's native ==highlight== syntax offers only one highlight color, and applying colored text requires manually writing HTML.
summary: Text highlighting plugin that shows a floating color palette next to selected text to apply background or text colors.
